## Every read-type command now returns in ~300ms or less. — 2026-08-01 (parent 4bbca07122de)

**Reduce all read-command latency to ~300ms by lazily loading the LLM SDK, fingerprint-gating check_project against the store, tailing audit logs, and demoting test paths in SQL grep ordering.**

The anthropic/pydantic_ai/httpx stack (~1.2 s) is now loaded on demand through `_sdk()`, a cached lazy accessor in `trie/models`. All runtime references in `TrieClient`, `_is_retryable`, and `_run_with_retry` go through `_sdk().X`; the module-level `_RETRYABLE_ANTHROPIC` tuple is removed. `FastMCP` is deferred into `build_server`. The CLI entrypoint sets `PYDANTIC_DISABLE_PLUGINS=__all__` before any pydantic import, cutting logfire autoload (~250 ms).

`check_project` gains an optional `store` parameter. When `sha256(file bytes)` matches the store's recorded fingerprint, `_check_project_inner` uses `Store.symbol_hashes_for_file` instead of re-parsing; misses fall through to a full parse. `TriefactFile.parse` adds `parse_front_matter=False` to skip YAML on the fast path; when YAML is needed, it prefers `CSafeLoader`. `_verify_drift`, `status_cmd`, `_run_single_file_sync`, and `compute_incremental_worklist` all pass the store through.

`AuditSummary.from_log` gains `tail_bytes` (default 4 MB via `_AUDIT_TAIL_BYTES`); `--all` reads everything.

`Store.grep_symbols` adds a SQL-level test-path demotion tier (tests/ roots, /tests/ dirs, `test_*` files, conftest) so a LIMITed page cannot be starved by alphabetically-earlier test symbols. `Store.symbol_hashes_for_file` is new.
